summary.text: Pete Flores, listed by Ballotpedia as Peter P. Flores, is a Republican member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 24 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A former game warden, he previously represented District 19 in the Senate from 2018 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Peter Flores was born in Minot, North Dakota, and lives in Pleasanton, Texas, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a B.S. in recreation and parks administration from Texas A&M University in 1983.
His career experience includes work as a game warden for the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department and as a consultant at the National Association of Conservation Law Enforcement Chiefs Academy.
Flores represented Texas State Senate District 19 from 2018 to 2021, when he was succeeded by Roland Gutierrez.

He assumed office as the senator for District 24 on January 10, 2023, and in 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Education, Finance, and Water, Agriculture, & Rural Affairs committees, as well as the Committee of the Whole Senate.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
